title: Functional and Quality of Life of Patients after Gender Reassignment Surgery
summary: The aim of this study is to create a database, where patients with gender dysphoria are prospectively evaluated. We want to do a systematic data analysis of the outcomes regarding quality of life and function. Included should be all patients, diagnosed with gender dysphoria male-to-female or female-to-male, that want to undergo genital affirming surgery in the Department of Urology of the Universitätsklinikum Mannheim and agree to participate. The literature doesn´t provide much data especially about functional data after genital affirming surgery in transgender patients. It is important for us surgeons as well as future patients, to collect data and to record the actual quality in the course of treatment. Thereby we hope to find possible improvements in the treatment and techniques. We are specifically interested in results regarding bladder- and sexual funcion, pain, cosmetical and functional outcomes as well as socio-psychological findings.

interventions.name: Data collection will take place at different moments (properatively, 6, 12, 24, 48 and 60 months postoperatively) via questionnaires.
